capabilities: Ingest new or changed raw files (Markdown, PDF, Office, HTML, images, code) into wiki pages via an LLM
Extract text from documents and use vision OCR for scanned PDFs, slides, and images
Chat with the wiki in a side panel using index-first retrieval
Lint the wiki for stale claims, contradictions, and missing pages
Preview, confirm, and atomically apply or roll back generated change plans
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README details privacy behavior: selected vault content and the API key are sent to the configured endpoint, and there is no telemetry or self-update mechanism.
motivation: The README says it helps turn raw source notes into a wiki that compounds over time instead of re-deriving knowledge from scratch on every query.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a folder of raw sources into a persistent, structured wiki that is kept up to date and queryable with AI help.

relations.evidence: Send only new or changed raw files to an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API URL, key, and model

summary: AI-assisted wiki maintainer that ingests raw source files into a structured wiki, answers chat queries against it, and lints pages via previewed change plans.
